name: Arya Vijayan
preview: The test was conducted on the SHL platform. Each section was timed. Questions cannot be skipped until they are answered, and we cannot return to previous questions...

name: Swetha Theresa George
preview: The first round was a written test comprising application-level questions. The assessment was open-book. One question presented a scenario involving the sorting of a 2GB file of random integers where the available RAM was limited to 1GB.  We were asked to devise an algorithm to efficiently handle this situation...

preview: Commvault’s recruitment process focuses on Cybersecurity, Software Development, and Software Testing. The overall process evaluates candidates based on problem-solving ability, conceptual understanding, and hands-on application — particularly in Operating Systems, Networking, and Secure Systems...

name: Gokul G Menon
preview: Air India came for placements in early October. This was after the first wave of companies that came during June-August. Air India involved 3 rounds after the initial coding test, first two being technical followed by a managerial HR. Since my intention was to get placed at companies that deal with Machine Learning...

name: Antony S John

The main two things you are going to hear about the company are they have a very good WLB going on, and that the projects they work on are usually not that challenging...
